chat.title: YLS Concierge
chat.subtitle: Answers routine questions in your language. Urgent or complex requests go to a licensed agent.
chat.chip.addDriver: What documents do I need to add a driver?
chat.chip.urgentCommercial: I need to change my commercial coverage immediately
chat.chip.status: What is the status of my request?
chat.reply.greeting: Hello! I'm the YLS concierge. I can help with required documents, request status, payments, and ID card or COI downloads. For coverage changes, I will connect you with a licensed agent.
chat.reply.docsAddDriver: To add a driver to an auto policy, please prepare:
chat.reply.newDriverLicense: The new driver's license or permit (front and back)
chat.reply.docsOutro: You can upload them in Guided Intake.
chat.reply.docsGeneric: The required documents depend on the insurance line. Open Guided Intake and choose a line to see your checklist.
chat.reply.download: Here are the documents on file for policy {{policy}}:
chat.reply.noDocument: I couldn't find that document on file for you. I can ask a licensed agent to send it.
chat.reply.contact: You can reach YLS Financial & Insurance Services through ylsins.com, or I can arrange a callback from a licensed agent.
chat.reply.payment: Premium payments are made through your insurance carrier's payment portal. Your carrier is {{carrier}}. If you need help finding the portal, I can arrange a callback.
chat.reply.paymentGeneric: Premium payments are made through your insurance carrier's payment portal. The carrier's name is on your policy documents. If you need help, I can arrange a callback.
chat.reply.statusComplete: Request {{id}} is complete and with a licensed agent for review.
chat.reply.statusNone: You have no open requests right now.
chat.reply.fallback: I can't answer that reliably. Would you like me to connect you with a licensed YLS agent?
chat.reply.handoff: I've sent a summary of your request in English to a licensed YLS agent, along with a callback request. Reference {{id}}.
chat.reply.needContact: To connect you with an agent, please share your name and phone number.
chat.banner.title: Warm Handoff Initiated
chat.banner.body: A structured English summary and a callback request were sent to a licensed YLS agent.
